description: This Java class 'VirtualFolderWrapper' implements the 'IAbstractFolder' interface, providing a wrapper around a VirtualFile representing a folder in an IDE environment. It offers methods for folder operations such as listing contents, retrieving files or subfolders, and getting folder metadata.

classes.name: VirtualFolderWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing IAbstractFolder, encapsulating a VirtualFile folder and providing folder operations.

methods.name: VirtualFolderWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with a project and a VirtualFile folder.

methods.name: hasFile
methods.description: Checks if a file with the given name exists in the folder.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file by name, returning a VirtualFileWrapper if found.

methods.name: getFolder
methods.description: Retrieves a subfolder by name, returning a new VirtualFolderWrapper if found.

methods.name: listMembers
methods.description: Lists all members (files and folders) within the folder.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists names of children matching an optional filter.

methods.name: getOsLocation
methods.description: Returns the folder's path in system-dependent format.

methods.name: getParentFolder
methods.description: Returns the parent folder wrapper, if any.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on folder and project.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on project and folder.
